title: Trump wants to 'take oil' in Iran as 'tit-for-tat violence' continues
summary: U.S. President Donald Trump has raised the idea of American forces seizing Iran’s Kharg Island, its main oil terminal in the Persian Gulf. This comes as US-Israeli strikes hit residential areas and other non-military targets in Tehran over the weekend. Iran has targeted industrial hubs in the region. FRANCE 24's Reza Sayah tells us more from Tehran.
